chrome_verdict: Dangerous file blocked; precise server-side detection reason is not exposed by the browser UI.
assessment: Defender did not reproduce a malware detection. This does not invalidate Chrome’s verdict or prove a false positive. No evidence supports assigning the exact Chrome cause to unsigned status alone.
release_requirements: Keep the blocked build out of normal distribution pending vendor review.
Use one native Windows installer with model resources; avoid a nested installer and PowerShell ExecutionPolicy Bypass in the customer installation flow.
Sign application, native binaries and final installer with trusted Authenticode publisher identity. Self-signed certificates and protection exclusions are not acceptable.
Run independent signed-payload integrity, antivirus, offline recognition and installation checks.
Submit the blocked exact hash/URL to Google for review through the supported vendor channel.
A new signed file can still require reputation review; do not promise that a signature alone removes every warning.
